name: multiselect

frames.best_why: Two chips plus a fully open list with the disabled row visible and no cursor over the options.

tagline: Type to filter a list and add picks as removable chips.
summary: A multi-choice field for picking several values from a searchable list. Chosen items appear as small chips with x buttons inside the input, and an open dropdown lists the remaining choices with a dimmed disabled one.
appearance: A dark rounded input under a bold label and above a tiny hint, holding small outlined chips with x buttons, a text caret and a clear-all x at the right. An open bordered dropdown beneath lists framework names in light grey, one of them dimmed.
behaviour: Focusing the box opens the dropdown; typing filters the list in place, and clicking a name turns it into a removable chip and drops it from the list. A chip's x or Backspace removes it, and the clear-all x empties the field.
demo_content: Framework names Next.js, Astro, React, Remix, SvelteKit, Nuxt.js, Vite, Angular and Gatsby.
search_phrases: choose several frameworks from a list
dropdown that adds chips as you pick
type to filter options in a box
form field that collects multiple values
use_when: A field needs several values from a known list, with chips showing what is already chosen.
avoid_when: Chips stay inside the field, so many picks wrap and push the open dropdown further down.
customise: Pass an options array, a controlled value and an onChange; flags cover search, pick limits, creatable entries and the clear button, while field and chip classes take styling.
weight_why: A filtered option list and chips; nothing runs while the field is closed.

a11y.note: Remove and clear buttons carry labels and focus rings show, but the chips and open list have no single announced multi-select name.

issues: The dropdown overlaps the helper line that sits directly under the field
The disabled Angular row is dimmed but otherwise looks the same as a live row
No frame shows the 'No results found' empty state
polish_why: Clear chip workflow, but the dropdown covers the helper line and the rows are tightly packed.
title: Multiselect
